payload.summary: Close current privacy provider, legal, and clinical approvals
payload.detail: Supersedes the external-evidence assumptions in archived #053 and #HVTYAT. On 2026-09-01 the OpenAI owner review confirmed API sharing and API call logging disabled and optional hosted tools disabled; OpenAI acknowledged the API for Enterprise ZDR request covering Responses, Embeddings, prompt caching, DPA, and Australia residency, but approval is pending. Release remains blocked on production HMAC and staging-retention owner attestations, OpenAI ZDR and countersigned DPA evidence, Railway sensitive-health terms, APP 8 and APP 1/5 privacy-adviser approval, and clinical PHI-minimisation acceptance. Evidence authority: docs/governance/privacy-readiness.v1.json and docs/governance/privacy-closeout-2026-09-01.md.
